directAnswer.en: This is a site without a stable grid for a pump motor. Open this row when the spray job has no 380 V supply. Power is printed as 28/32 HP, particle ≤6 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine at diesel engine 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 80 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm and 480 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Type 511 Diesel, which prints diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. No kilowatt figure is printed. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the material, the largest particle, the sand-cement ratio, the hose length you measured, and whether the site can supply the printed power. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
